body: The agent crashes with `TurnTimeoutError` after 90 seconds when the Ollama provider is slow to answer. Steps: 1) start `ollama serve`, 2) run any agent with provider ollama and model qwen2.5:1.5b, 3) send a prompt that needs a tool call. Expected: the turn waits for the model or reports a clear provider timeout. Actual: the run aborts after exactly 90 seconds with a generic timeout and the session is left half-finished.
title: Agent crashes with TurnTimeoutError when the Ollama provider is slow
